ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw report was ingested into the dashboard by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file from which this record was extracted

reportFolder.description: Folder or path of the source report file from which this record was extracted

product_id.description: Product identifier from the PRIP interface (OData Id)

product_name.description: Product file name from the PRIP interface (OData Name)

packet_store_id.description: Packet store identifier used to derive S1 raw product timeliness (NRT-PT/NTC)

content_length.description: Product file size in bytes (OData ContentLength)

publication_date.description: Date the product was published on the PRIP interface (OData PublicationDate)

fos_pushing_date_backup.description: Date the product was pushed by the FOS backup chain, used for HKTM completeness

fos_pushing_date_nominal.description: Date the product was pushed by the FOS nominal chain, used for HKTM completeness

interface_name.description: Name of the PRIP interface instance the product was collected from

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the product (PRIP)

production_service_name.description: Name of the PRIP production service instance providing the product

eviction_date.description: Date the product is scheduled to be evicted from the PRIP interface (OData EvictionDate)

origin_date.description: Product origin date at the source (OData OriginDate)

footprint.description: Geographic footprint of the product (OData GeoFootprint), populated for selected product types

product_group_id.description: Product group identifier grouping related S2 products (OData Attribute productGroupId)

datastrip_id.description: Datastrip identifier of the product for S2 (OData Attribute datastripId)

quality_status.description: Quality status of the product (OData Attribute qualityStatus)

cloud_cover.description: Cloud cover percentage of the product (OData Attribute cloudCover)
